title: Banana by Skwezed 100ml
description:
Banana by Skwezed 100ml
It’s time to go B-a-n-a-n-a-s! We’ve all loved bananas for so long but now it’s time to expand the love. What if this sweet and ripe fruit turns out to be an exotic and refreshing e-liquid? With Skwezed’s intensifying Banana E-liquid, you can enjoy tons of tropical sweetness with a fruity essence attached to it.
A versatile tropical fix is a must-try for all the banana lovers out there! Whether it’s a sunny day or a chilly night, keep your taste buds banana-fied with our irresistible, luscious, and juicy Banana E-liquid.
The best part about this fruity-flavored banana is its ripening distinguished taste that delivers a blended fun experience to fulfill a banana craving.
WARNING:
This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is an addictive chemical
Primary Flavors:
Banana
